definitions: Myles Garrett is an American professional football defensive end for the Cleveland Browns of the National Football League (NFL).
Myles Garrett is known for his exceptional athleticism, strength, and pass-rushing abilities.
examples: Myles Garrett was drafted first overall in the 2017 NFL Draft.
Fans often discuss Myles Garrett's impact on the Browns' defense.
The opposing team struggled to block Myles Garrett.
